card.name: Dosing-schedule words in dose instructions
card.fires_on: Words inside dosing instructions that lead into a frequency or schedule, such as 'Sup|pressive' therapy, 'per day', 'four times' daily or 'mg' after an initial dose. Also fires partway through some drug names.

modes.label: Suppressive therapy
modes.description: The ending of 'Suppressive' in a herpes dosing heading.
modes.example: Genital herpes: Sup<<pressive>> therapy Immunocompetent patients 1

modes.label: Frequency words
modes.description: Day, times or mg in statements of how often or how much to take.
modes.example: applied topically in the eye(s) upto four<< times>> daily.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of long drug names in dosing text.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about monthly or daily timing, such as 'monthly' and '_daily'.
card.plain: It lights up on dosing-schedule wording, like how many times a day a drug is given.
